summary.plain: A small tabletop instrument built at the University of Washington that catches the faint radio hum a single electron makes as it spirals in a magnetic field, the first step toward weighing the neutrino this way.
summary.technical: Project 8 Phase I CRES apparatus: single-electron cyclotron-radiation detection cell in a ~1 T magnetic field, demonstrated on 83mKr conversion electrons at the University of Washington (2015); later phases add gaseous tritium sources.

technology.locator: Project 8 Phase II apparatus paper, abstract
technology.quote: Cyclotron Radiation Emission Spectroscopy (CRES) is a novel technique for the precise measurement of relativistic electron energy.
technology.value: Cyclotron Radiation Emission Spectroscopy (CRES): single-electron microwave radiometry in a magnetic trap
